## `src/regalloc/graph-coloring`

### GraphColoringRegisterAllocator

**Kind:** class

```typescript
export class GraphColoringRegisterAllocator
```

Chaitin-Briggs Iterative Graph Coloring Register Allocator.
Computes multi-block liveness analysis, builds interference graphs, performs Briggs/George
conservative move coalescing, applies loop-depth-aware spill weighting, and colors registers.

## `src/regalloc/linear-scan`

### LinearScanRegisterAllocator

**Kind:** class

```typescript
export class LinearScanRegisterAllocator
```

Fast Linear Scan Register Allocator with multi-class support, fixed constraints,
calling convention clobber awareness, and loop-depth-aware spill weighting.
